title: M5GFX #431: LP I2C FIFO depth read as 32 on ESP-IDF 6.x (code-level verification)

hardware.detail: No ESP32-C5 / C6 / P4 board available. The NFC-V and byte-boundary measurements quoted in the issue are the reporter's own data in PR #432; not re-run here.

execution.environment: macOS arm64 read-only source inspection; ESP-IDF v6.1 local source tree for header facts; M5GFX develop 43a8719 and reported commit 452c15b; host compile of the extracted isLpPort/getFifoLen with Apple clang 21 at -Wall -Wextra -Werror; no idf.py build; local Device Service exposes 36 profiles with no ESP32-C5 and tab5 disabled; esp-emulator has no LP I2C controller model

checks.detail: Issue OPEN, 0 comments before handling, author GOB52, Japanese title/body, no m5agent reply exists
452c15b common.inl:1464-1476 checks only SOC_LP_I2C_FIFO_LEN / SOC_I2C_FIFO_LEN and falls back to return 32; no I2C_LL_* branch
origin/develop 43a8719 common.inl:1465-1484 has I2C_LL_LP_FIFO_LEN and I2C_LL_FIFO_LEN branches plus the #433 #error guard at :1471-1473
ESP-IDF v6.1 tree: zero SOC_I2C_FIFO_LEN / SOC_LP_I2C_FIFO_LEN hits under components/soc and components/esp_hal_i2c; I2C_LL_* present per chip
Extracted functions with real IDF 6.1 macro sets: base returns 32 for C5/C6/P4 LP and C2, head returns 16 for C5/C6 LP, P4 port2, and C2 HP; 5.5.4 macro sets identical in both
writeBytes first chunk ((length-1) % limit) + 1 (common.inl:2763): limit=32 gives a single 17/18/24-byte chunk; limit=16 keeps every chunk <= 16 and preserves total length
Synthetic LP port with neither depth macro: base compiles and returns 32, head stops with the #error message
git tag --contains e88846e is empty; latest release 0.3.0 (28d4794, 2026-11-06) contains no I2C_LL_LP_FIFO_LEN, so 0.3.0 + ESP-IDF 6.x still reproduces
No C5/C6/P4 hardware and no substitute board exercising the LP I2C FIFO

No ESP32-C5 profile among 36 Device Service profiles; C6 profiles exist but esp-emulator has no LP I2C controller model (0 lp_i2c hits, classic model only 32-byte FIFO); tab5 disabled and its I2C is static register probes, so a >16-byte silent corruption cannot be observed
Headers read from the local v6.1 tree; no idf.py build for C5/C6/P4 and upstream CI results not re-run
